Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two tracked parts for this test at a cost of $10.00 and a Sell Price of $20.00: part A with 0 in its only bin and part B with 4 in its only bin.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425661 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425661-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 0 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425661 PART B in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425661-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line while its bin holds 0, so part A's bin goes to -2.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425661 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the work order's Lines tab, in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425661-A in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 2 in Qty *, then click Save.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
    • How to do it: The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425661-.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value under PARTS in the left menu), with the as-of date on today.
